The Agenda
programme.desc: A weekly talk-show looking beyond the headlines and “accepted wisdom” to find the real story. Hosted by award-winning journalist and presenter Stephen Cole, The Agenda quite simply sets The Agenda . You won't find the same-old talking heads recycling platitudes; instead thought-provoking guests to debate and explore key issues of today's world. Using virtual reality graphics to bring subjects to life, Stephen will navigate through subjects ranging from “Prove That Climate Change Exists” to “Who Will Win the Race to Space”. Opposing views will be given opportunity to flourish and develop into a meaningful conversation. The Agenda: No nonsense talk; Challenging perceptions.

programme.title: E24 - The Charm Of A Winter In Corsica
programme.desc: Winter in Corsica is an invitation to discover an island with a beating heart, far from the summer crowds. A season when the true Corsican soul is revealed, between preserved traditions and moments of shared conviviality. The ideal time to appreciate the true Corsican art of living and its ancestral traditions.

programme.title: E32 - Family Home With Zen Decoration
programme.desc: Visit of a family house with soft and zen decoration that invites to rest and disconnect in the north of France. Also: discovery of the farm of Petit Bomal; a point with Anne on photovoltaic; how to mount a fence in chestnut.

E2 - Mia & Max's Artsy August Picnic
programme.desc: Have an Artsy August picnic! Join Mia and Max for some messy painting, then put on a performance of Humpty Dumpty. Create a Dinosaur Cafe for snacks, learn about families, and play This Little Piggy after a fun day in the garden!

programme.title: E2 - Construction Chaos & Clever Fixes
programme.desc: Get ready for some construction chaos & clever fixes! First, Mr. Rubble is very tired & puts the plans on the board upside down, causing the crew to build a house upside down! Then, while building a roundabout, the crew finds some big old dinosaur bones! The chaos continues as a power cut stops all their machines, so they hook everything up to clean solar panels instead. From building a pond for frogs to building themselves into a box, it's always chaotic!

programme.title: E10 - Baby John's Artsy August Day
programme.desc: Let's get baking this Artsy August! Follow a picture cookbook with Baby John and Manny to make muffins, but get ready for a mess! Then, celebrate Dia de los Muertos, build toy boats, and have a fun, paint-splattering race in the garden!

programme.title: E24 - Cody's Artsy August Music Makers
programme.desc: Make music this Artsy August! Discover amazing sounds as Cody's dad plays African instruments. Then, play with an empty cardboard box, go on a rainbow flower scavenger hunt, and dance with adorable baby animals at the zoo!

programme.title: E1 - When Buster's Dreams Come to Life!
programme.desc: Join Buster as his amazing dreams come to life! First, he dreams he is a fish, complete with a tail & fins! He's scared when he meets a big shark, but soon learns the shark just wants a friend to play with. Then, it's all stations go as Buster dreams he's a space rocket & blasts off to tour all the planets! The dreams continue as he becomes Sheriff Buster in the wild west & finds a magic spell book that causes all sorts of trouble!

programme.title: E1 - When Buster Becomes a Superhero!
programme.desc: Watch as Buster becomes a real-life superhero! When a storm starts during a nature walk, everyone panics, but it's up to brave Buster to lead them all safely home through the rain & wind. Then, Buster wants to be an emergency vehicle. programme.title: E1
programme.desc: 根據小說《Sales夫婦》改編。一場盛宴之下的狂歡，讓隱藏已久的暗湧現，喚醒了所有裝睡的人，也觸發了GST酒業各層人士的生存危機。一切事關生存，每一步都需格外謹慎。七個深陷其中的主要人物，在事件中扮演了不同的角色，勾勒出人性的複雜和現實的殘酷，從而呈現出一個共同的主題——如何在惶惶不安中樂觀地活下去！

programme.title: E6
programme.desc: 《虎鶴妖師錄》講述了樂觀開朗的山野孤兒虎子因誤打誤撞吞食了至陽寶物赤珠，而結識了冷峻潔癖的國御妖師隊長祁曉軒。兩個性格迥異的年輕人因一顆赤珠被迫一起上路，結識了趙馨彤、王羽千、 山茶等夥伴，就在人妖兩界的野心要為人間帶來一場浩劫之時，一眾有夢想的熱血少年不惜自我犧牲，拯救人間的故事。

programme.title: E22
programme.desc: 高冷孤僻的企業繼承人顧榮儼然是個“傲嬌公子”，而看似軟萌文靜的少女蘇靜靜實則武藝不凡。一場意外讓“元氣少女”蘇靜靜與“不食人間煙火”的顧榮產生交集，還成為他的貼身保鏢。性格、習慣大相徑庭的兩人不得不開啟室友生活，在追求人生目標中攜手蛻變與成長……
